crossRefs.note: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of…
Do they provoke me to anger?” says Yahweh. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”
“For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth…
They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will…
They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold…
because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came…
“Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets…
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

translations.web: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says Yahweh; “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”
translations.bsb: ‘But to your own harm, you have not listened to Me,’ declares the LORD, ‘so you have provoked Me to anger with the works of your hands.’
translations.kjv: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
translations.asv: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith Jehovah; that ye may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.
